answer: A farm cannot pre-compute those re-asks, as the sample is drawn from the tide beacon after the epoch ends and the whisper nonce differs from the first. Since the voyage audit keeps both texts, an operator that cannot answer again loses everything it earned, which is a cost that falls only on fabricated work. Each close, 6% of settled answers are re-asked under a fresh nonce, and a failed re-ask claws back the original reward. That is 16 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
